explanation: No side is selected by default. pathDecisions uses profile-id:relative/path and accepts source/upstream/merge. hunkDecisions uses generated h_ IDs and accepts source/upstream. Required review paths block READY until the owner chooses.

reviewRequired.stronghold-server:data/config.json: OWNER DECISION: Boss HP scaling differs. Source uses perPlayer=false, solo=0.25 and aliveScaling=true; upstream v0.2.5 uses a different per-player/coop model.
reviewRequired.stronghold-server:server/lobby.js: OWNER DECISION: public matchmaking, experimental room capacity and lobby lifecycle intersect upstream state/protocol changes.
reviewRequired.stronghold-server:shared/protocol.js: OWNER DECISION: custom message types must stay paired with client and server handlers.
reviewRequired.stronghold-server:server/match/match/set: OWNER DECISION: rescue/revival settlement intersects the newer upstream settlement lifecycle.
reviewRequired.stronghold-server:server/match/unite.js: OWNER DECISION: the second cooperative-defense relay changes gameplay progression.
reviewRequired.stronghold-server:server/index.js: OWNER DECISION: worker pool, health/traffic instrumentation and startup/shutdown are central lifecycle hooks.
reviewRequired.stronghold-server-server-agent:server/lo: OWNER DECISION: rehearsal/freeze hooks must be checked against the other feature layer and newer upstream lobby.
reviewRequired.stronghold-server-server-agent:server/ma: OWNER DECISION: host-browser AI rehearsal alters preparation-phase behavior and needs paired client/worker paths.
reviewRequired.stronghold-server-server-agent:server/in: OWNER DECISION: asset/traffic and Agent initialization touch server startup.
